import cadquery as cq

# plate X 0..40, Y 0..20, Z 0..4
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(40, 20, 4, centered=False)

# round boss diameter 10 at (10,10) on top of plate, Z 4..14
boss = cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(10, 10, 4)).circle(5).extrude(10)
result = plate.union(boss)

# 3 mm hole along Z through boss and plate at (10,10)
hole = cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(10, 10, 0)).circle(1.5).extrude(30)
result = result.cut(hole)

# slot through plate: obround 16 long x 6 wide, long side along Y, centred at (28,10)
slot = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, 4))
    .center(28, 10)
    .slot2D(16, 6, angle=90)   # 16 end-to-end, 6 wide, rotated to Y
    .extrude(4, both=True)     # through the 4 mm plate
)
result = result.cut(slot)

import cadquery as cq

# Plate X 0-40, Y 0-20, Z 0-4  (centered=False puts the corner at the origin)
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(40, 20, 4, centered=False)

# Round boss diameter 10 on top at (10,10), Z 4-14
boss = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, 4))
    .center(10, 10)
    .circle(5)
    .extrude(10)
)

# 3 mm hole along Z through boss and plate, centred at (10,10)
hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(10, 10)
    .circle(1.5)
    .extrude(20)  # covers plate 0-4 and boss 4-14
)

# Slot through plate: obround 16 long end-to-end, 6 wide, long side along Y, centred at (28,10)
slot = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(28, 10)
    .slot2D(16, 6, 90)  # 90° => long side along Y
    .extrude(4)  # through the 4 mm plate
)

result = plate.union(boss).cut(hole).cut(slot)
